content.title: RBC Bearings (NYSE:RBC) Exceeds Q3 Expectations

The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $458 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.88 per share was 5.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
